'''Soul Link''' is a [[Link skill]] that targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your [[Energy Shield]] intercepts some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

==Skill Functions and Interactions==
* Intercepting damage '''does''' count as losing [[Energy Shield]] to damage, and therefore will interrupt Energy Shield's recharge and reset its recharge cooldown.
* Damage intercepted by the player is not considered as hit and therefore doesn't trigger {{c|mod|if you’ve been Hit}} effects.
* Player defenses have no influence on intercepted damage. Only linked target defenses are taken into consideration. 
** For example, if you have 50% Fire Resistance and your linked target has only 10% Fire Resistance, when hit by 100 fire damage, your linked target's defenses will lower this amount down to 90 fire damage, from which you will intercept 27 (30% of 90) damage, which will result in your linked target suffering only 63 fire damage.
** Likewise, if you have 0% Fire Resistance and your linked target has 75% Fire Resistance, when hit by 100 fire damage, your linked target's defenses will lower this amount down to 25 fire damage, from which you will intercept 7.5 (30% from 25) damage, resulting in your linked target suffering only 17.5 fire damage.
** Note that for clarity sake none of the above examples incorporates {{c|mod|Linked target takes (5-14)% less Damage}} component of this skill.

See the [[Link skill|link]] page for more details.
